newsitem.title: CHINA: SHENZHEN FIYTA UP 7.95 PCT IN EARLY TRADE.
newsitem.headline: SHENZHEN FIYTA UP 7.95 PCT IN EARLY TRADE.

text.p: Shenzhen Fiyta Holdings Ltd's B shares leapt 7.95 percent to HK$6.65 in early Wednesday trading, extending a strong run that began on Tuesday after the announcement of good 1997 interim results, brokers said.
Turnover was 105,100 shares at 10.00 a.m. (0200 GMT), making it one of the most actively traded issues.
"Yesterday's interim results powered Fiyta," an analyst at China Southern Securities said. "Many investors were surprised."
Fiyta on Tuesday reported an 85 percent year-on-year surge in net profits to 48.55 million yuan for the first half of 1997 based on Chinese accounting standards.
Based on international standards, it posted net profits of 45.79 million yuan for the period but gave no comparative figures.
On Tuesday, the issue hit its 10 percent limit-up level by early afternoon.
